title: Machine learning predicts response to transcranial current stimulation from resting EEG
summary: A machine learning pipeline predicted arm-speed response to 70 Hz motor cortex tACS from high-gamma (90 to 160 Hz) resting-state EEG in a crossover study, and in a prospective stimulation study stratification increased the behavioural effect size. Sample sizes are not given in the abstract. This is the first posted bioRxiv version.
